tools.name: council_query
tools.description: Send a prompt to a council of frontier AI models across 9 labs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, Moonshot, z.ai). Returns each model's independent response plus a moderator-synthesized consensus answer with an agreement score and the key point of disagreement, when one exists

tools.name: council_result
tools.description: Fetch the result of a council_query started with async=true. Returns status "running" while the council is still working (wait 30-60 seconds and call again), the full synthesis + per-model responses once complete, or status "failed" with the error. Polling is free — the council run itself was alread

tools.name: council_query_with_rag
tools.description: Like council_query, but first retrieves the most relevant passages from the user's personal Council RAG library (uploaded PDFs, Word docs, contracts, research papers, codebases) and injects them into every model's prompt. Use when the question is about content the user has uploaded — contract review

tools.name: council_review
tools.description: Multi-model code review. Sends a unified diff (or code snippet) to multiple frontier AI models from different labs in parallel, each acting as an independent reviewer with an explicit verdict + findings contract. Returns a verdict-first synthesis: overall SHIP/NO-SHIP, consensus score, confirmed fin

tools.name: library_search
tools.description: Semantic search over the user's Council RAG library (uploaded PDFs, Word docs, contracts, research papers, codebases). Returns top-K chunks with source filename and page number. tools.name: library_list
tools.description: List the documents in the user's Council RAG library. Returns id, filename, source type, ingestion status, chunk count, and upload date for each document. No retrieval, no budget consumption.

tools.name: library_upload
tools.description: Upload a document into the user's Council RAG library so future council_query_with_rag and library_search calls can retrieve it. tools.description: Permanently delete a document from the user's Council RAG library — the record, every indexed chunk, AND the stored file are removed. tools.name: council_models
tools.description: List the AI models available to the current user. Returns ID, provider, tier, context window, and capability flags (web search, vision, streaming). Use the IDs returned here as the `models` array argument to council_query / council_query_with_rag.

tools.name: council_usage
tools.description: Return the user's current monthly cost-budget consumption (current spend, budget cap, percentage used, days until reset). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: council_query · Private data: council_review, library_list, library_upload, library_delete · Public sink: council_query, library_list, library_upload, library_delete · Destructive: council_query, council_result, library_delete, council_usage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: council_query · Private data: council_review, library_list, library_upload, library_delete · Public sink: council_query, library_list, library_upload, library_delete · Destructive: council_query, council_result, library_delete, council_usage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
